sentences.text: Tianyuornis was roughly the same size as modern phoebes.
This bird is distinguished by unique features including a straight lower jaw and teeth preserved in both the upper and lower jaws.
Fossils of Tianyuornis were found in lake deposits within the Yixian Formation in Inner Mongolia, China.
Tianyuornis is classified as a genus of ornithuromorph birds.
It belongs to the family Hongshanornithidae.
The type species of the genus Tianyuornis is Tianyuornis cheni.
Tianyuornis lived during the Early Cretaceous period, specifically from the Barremian to Aptian stages.
Specifically, the animal lived between 125.77 and 121.4 million years ago during the Barremian stage.
The presence of teeth in Tianyuornis supports the controversial hypothesis that other members of the Hongshanornithidae family also possessed teeth.
